verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documentation that ELSTER publishes, before a filer starts, any operating-hours window, per-day submission limit, or session timeout for the online flow. The only related item is a pointer to a server-availability status page, which is an adjacent feature and not disclosure of these constraints, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
